findings.title: Overdue check compares dates in the server's time zone
findings.detail: No test runs the ordering with a non-UTC time zone, so the time-zone bug in the overdue check is not caught.
findings.suggestion: Add a test that sets TZ and checks a task due today is not overdue.

findings.title: Ordering test relies on insertion order for equal due dates
findings.detail: Two tasks with the same due date are expected in creation order, but they are created in the same millisecond on fast machines.
findings.suggestion: Give the two tasks explicit, different createdAt values.
